starters.name: Sample outbound campaign doc
starters.description: A multi-page doc with a campaign built for one account: strategy, segment and funnel charts, sample leads from Ken Search, and graded first emails. Downloads as a PDF.

starters.name: We built you a campaign
starters.description: A one-page campaign preview for an account: the people Ken Search found for them and the first emails, written by Ken's copy step.

starters.name: Your product, run on their data
starters.description: Shows an account what your product finds when it runs on their own data. Your endpoint does the work through a webhook step.

starters.name: Peer benchmark report
starters.description: A short report that puts one account next to its peers, from a CSV you upload to the template. Downloads as a PDF.

starters.name: Website audit with rewrites
starters.description: Scrapes an account's site, lists what gets in a buyer's way, and rewrites three pieces of copy. A grader checks the rewrites before the page goes out.

starters.name: Dinner or webinar invite
starters.description: A personal invite to a dinner or webinar with a form that saves the seat. Each submission becomes a signal on the account.

starters.name: Built for you case study
starters.description: Picks the customer story closest to each account from a CSV of your case studies and retells it for them.

starters.name: Role pitch for one candidate
starters.description: One page per candidate on a recruiting campaign: why their background fits the role, the role and the team, the pay range and the hiring process, with a booking button and an optional video from the hiring manager.

starters.name: Roles for you
starters.description: One page per candidate listing the campaign's open roles that fit them, each with a short line on why, a button to book a call and a link to the job.

starters.name: Top 25 list
starters.description: A ranked list of companies in the account's market that are adding people, with the account placed on it and a note on how the list was made.
